photoCapture.label: Setshwantsho
photoCapture.hint: PNG, JPG kapa WEBP, ho fihla ho 5MB. Sellathekeng, sena se bula khamera ya hao; komporong, kgetha setshwantsho se seng.
photoCapture.idHelp: Se sebediswa ID/pasepoto ya hao mme se bontshwa mohlanka ya hlahlobang kopo ya hao.
photoCapture.wrongType: Ka kopo kgetha setshwantsho sa PNG, JPG kapa WEBP.
photoCapture.tooLarge: Setshwantsho seo se seholo haholo — ka kopo kgetha se ka tlase ho 5MB.
photoCapture.required: Ka kopo kenya setshwantsho pele o romela.
photoCapture.noFace: Ha re a fumana sefahleho setshwantshong seo. Ka kopo kgetha setshwantsho se hlakileng se bontshang sefahleho sa hao.
photoCapture.multipleFaces: Ho fumanwe difahleho tse fetang e le nngwe setshwantshong seo. Ka kopo kgetha setshwantsho sa hao o le mong.
photoCapture.tooFar: Sefahleho sa hao se senyenyane haholo setshwantshong sena — ka kopo atamela kapa o sitise setshwantsho pele o romela.
photoCapture.offCenter: Ka kopo beha sefahleho sa hao bohareng ba setshwantsho pele o se romela.
photoCapture.blurry: Setshwantsho sena ha se hlake hantle. Ka kopo tshwara khamera ka tsitsipano, netefatsa hore se hlakile, mme o nke setshwantsho hape.
photoCapture.notFacingForward: Ka kopo shebana le khamera ka kotloloho, hlooho e lekane e sa sekamela lehlakoreng.
photoCapture.busyBackground: Semelo se ka morao se bonahala se tletse dintho. Ka kopo nka setshwantsho hape moo ho nang le semelo se bobebe, se tsitsitseng.
photoCapture.obstructionConfirm: Ke netefatsa hore setshwantsho sena se bontsha sefahleho le hlooho ya ka ka botlalo, ntle le katiba, mahalima a letsatsi, kapa ntho e nngwe e thibelang.

instructions.title: Ditaelo tsa ho Nka Setshwantsho
instructions.noHat: Tlosa katiba, kepisi, kapa ntho efe kapa efe e koahelang hlooho (ntho e aparwang letsatsi le letsatsi ka lebaka la bodumedi ya dumelletswe, hafeela sefahleho sa hao ka botlalo se bonahala)
instructions.noGlasses: Tlosa diaparo tsa mahlo tse fifetseng kapa tse thibelang leseli
instructions.noHeadphones: Tlosa diaparo tsa ditsebe (headphones) kapa ditsebe tse nyenyane tsa molumo
instructions.lookStraight: Sheba khamera ka kotloloho, hlooho e lekane, sefahleho se sa fetohe
instructions.plainBackground: Ema moo ho nang le semelo se bobebe, se kganyang hantle — eseng lebota le nang le mefuta ya mebala kapa phaposi e tletseng dintho
instructions.steady: Tshwara khamera ka tsitsipano hore setshwantsho se hlakile, se se fifala

photoCapture.hat: Katiba kapa cap e fumanoe setshwantshong seo. Litshwantsho tsa Boitsebiso tsa Lekala la Merero ya Kahare ha li lumelloe ho bontsha hlooho e apesitsoeng ka mofuta ofe kapa ofe — ka kopo e tlose ebe oa nka setshwantsho hape.
photoCapture.cameraUnavailable: Khamera ha e khone ho bulwa mochining ona — kgetha setshwantsho se seng sa pele ho eng hore.
photoCapture.cameraFallbackHint: PNG, JPG kapa WEBP, ho fihla ho 5MB.
photoCapture.scanInProgressHint: Beha sefahleho sa hau bohareng ba foto, ebe o tobetsa Nka setshwantsho.
photoCapture.glasses: Ho fumanwe mahalima a mahlo, mahalima a letsatsi kapa dintho tse jwalo setshwantshong seo. Litshwantsho tsa Boitsebiso tsa Lekala la Merero ya Kahare ha li lumelloe ho bontsha dintho tse jwalo mahlong — ka kopo e tlose ebe o nka setshwantsho hape.
photoCapture.faceObstruction: Ho bonahala eka ho na le ntho e koahelang karolo ya sefahleho sa hao (jwalo ka maske, mosese wa molala, kapa letsoho). Litshwantsho tsa Boitsebiso tsa Lekala la Merero ya Kahare di tlameha ho bontsha sefahleho sa hao ka botlalo — ka kopo nka setshwantsho hape ntle le ntho e koahelang sefahleho sa hao.
photoCapture.faceCount: Netefatsa hore ke sefahleho sa motho a le mong feela se bonahalang hantle setshwantshong, ntle le ntho e nngwe.
photoCapture.unclear: Ha re a khona ho netefatsa setshwantsho sena ka ho hlaka. Ka kopo nka setshwantsho hape moo sefahleho sa hao se bonahalang ka botlalo, ho na le semelo se bobebe ka morao.

biometricCapture.hint: E sebelisetsoa ho ngolisa sebopeho sa letsoho bakeng sa karete ena ea Boitsebiso ba Naha.
biometricCapture.scanHint: Beha letsoho lena le otlolohile 'me o le sekene — ngodiso ya nnete e nka tlhahlobo ya letsoho le leng le le leng, eseng setshwantsho se le seng.
biometricCapture.captureHint: PNG, JPG kapa WEBP, ho fihla ho 5MB.
biometricCapture.wrongType: Ka kopo kgetha setshwantsho sa PNG, JPG kapa WEBP.
biometricCapture.tooLarge: Setshwantsho seo se seholo haholo — ka kopo kgetha se ka tlase ho 5MB.
biometricCapture.required: Tlhahlobo ya matsoho ka bobedi e hlokahala pele o romela.
biometricCapture.scanInProgressHint: Tshwara letsoho la hao le sa sisinyehe ka hara foreimi, ebe o tobetsa Nka tlhahlobo.
biometricCapture.cameraUnavailable: Khamera ha e fumanehe setsebeng sena — ka kopo kgetha setshwantsho se seng.
biometricCapture.noHandDetected: Ha ho letsoho le fumanoeng sekaneng seo — etsa bonnete ba hore letsoho le bulehileng le tlatsa sebaka se seholo sa foto, ebe oa leka hape.
biometricCapture.handTooFar: Letsoho la hau le hole haholo le khamera — le atamedise ebe oa leka hape.
biometricCapture.handTooClose: Letsoho la hau le haufi haholo le khamera — le khaotse hanyane ebe oa leka hape.
biometricCapture.tooFewFingersVisible: Menoana e mengata ha e bonahale sekaneng seo — tsamaisa letsoho la hau le bulehile le menoana e hasane, ebe oa leka hape.
biometricCapture.enrollWarning: Sekane se ngolisitsoe, empa ho ngolisa sena rekoto ea hau ho hlolehile — u ka leka hape hamorao ho tsoa ho Profile ea hau.
